IC1.IC1.2: Individuals must be symptomatic with respiratory symptoms

IC2.IC2.1: Individuals must complete the UCAP-Q questionnaire and score a ≥ 6% probability of having either asthma or COPD.
IC2.IC2.2: Individuals who have given written informed consent to participate in this trial in accordance with local regulations

IC.IC3: Individual must be able to perform pre and post bronchodilator spirometry to measure lung function

EC1.EC1.1: Individuals who report a previous diagnosis of asthma, COPD, history of lung cancer, bronchiectasis, interstitial lung disease, cystic fibrosis or other significant diagnosed lung disease.

EC.EC2: Individuals currently under the care of a Respirologist.
EC.EC3: Individuals currently using inhaled corticosteroids or long-acting bronchodilators.
EC.EC4: Individuals with history of myocardial infarction, stroke, aortic or cerebral aneurysm, or detached retina or eye surgery within the past 3 months (spirometry is contraindicated).
EC.EC5: Individuals who are in the third trimester of pregnancy
EC.EC6: Individuals involved in another interventional trial.
